searchText: hello frens, I have been encountering a puzzling behaviour in the resp/req domain, so according to spec https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/phase0/p2p-interface.md, each response should be prefixed with length of ssz payload but lightclient_finalty_update is prefixed with 6 bytes (excluding status code)? also seems to me like this request is implemented only in nimbus so maybe it has something to do with <@&595681804422479873> code? it seems weird that the length prefix to be 6 bytes, is there something added to the mix
